definition: A mechanism that weighs how relevant every other token is to the current one.
details: Queries, keys and values are combined with a softmax over scaled dot products.

definition: Generation conditioned on documents retrieved for the query.
details: A retriever fetches passages that are added to the prompt before the model answers.

citation.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

definition: A neural language model with billions of parameters trained on large text corpora.
details: LLMs are usually decoder-only Transformers trained with next-token prediction.

definition: A layer that routes each token to a few of many expert sub-networks.
details: A gating network picks the top-k experts so compute grows slower than parameters.

definition: Fine-tuning that trains low-rank update matrices instead of full weights.
details: Frozen weights are adapted by adding the product of two small trainable matrices.

definition: Stored attention keys and values reused across decoding steps.
details: Caching avoids recomputing past tokens, trading memory for speed.

definition: A probabilistic classifier that assumes features are independent given the class.
details: Despite the strong assumption it is a fast, competitive baseline for text classification.
